events.quote_anchor: “How did you get to the motel so fast?” he asked. The question had been irking him, like a pebble in his shoe.

events.quote_anchor: he fetched a second bottle from the center console and tipped a charcoal-colored pill into his palm, swallowing dry, hoping Victor wouldn’t notice.

relations.quote_anchor: “Jealous?” he said dryly as he put the phone away. “We’re not. But we have a mutual interest.”

numbers.did: had known Victor for nearly thirteen years
numbers.quote_anchor: MITCH had known Victor for nearly thirteen years, and in that time, he’d almost never seen the other man sleep.
